comparison.objective: Distinct: reorient and place two eggs small-end down in carton cups, versus tune and lock an industrial-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Egg handling tests gentle grasping, wrist reorientation, placement and release. The candidate tests recessed-tool insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, bounded tightening, physical control actuation and iterative response assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires both eggs within 4 mm of cup axes, below the rims, within 20 degrees of small-end-down, at rest and released for 1 s. Candidate requires two non-bottoming, non-rebounding, non-overloaded locked cycles. Candidate lacks numeric drift, rebound and overload limits; the egg rubric lacks a crack/damage condition despite rigid-shell fidelity, but the objectives remain clearly unrelated.
comparison.reason: Neither the manipulated mechanism nor the tested control ability overlaps beyond generic grasp-and-place primitives.
